name: @lattice-php/monorepo
description: Development monorepo for the Lattice packages.
author: Manuel Christlieb <manuel@christlieb.eu>

scripts.build:lib: npm run build --workspace @lattice-php/core && npm run build --workspace @lattice-php/ui && npm run build --workspace @lattice-php/form && npm run build --workspace @lattice-php/table && npm run build --workspace @lattice-php/action && npm run build --workspace @lattice-php/lattice && npm run build --workspace @lattice-php/api-reference
scripts.check: npm run versions:check && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run type-coverage && npm run test && npm run build:lib && npm run check:package
scripts.check:push: npm run versions:check && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run type-coverage && npm run test:changed && npm run build:lib
scripts.check:package: publint packages/framework --strict && attw --pack packages/framework --profile esm-only --exclude-entrypoints ./css ./css-full --ignore-rules internal-resolution-error && publint packages/core --strict && attw --pack packages/core --profile esm-only && publint packages/ui --strict && attw --pack packages/ui --profile esm-only --exclude-entrypoints ./css && publint packages/form --strict && attw --pack packages/form --profile esm-only --ignore-rules internal-resolution-error && publint packages/table --strict && attw --pack packages/table --profile esm-only --ignore-rules internal-resolution-error && publint packages/action --strict && attw --pack packages/action --profile esm-only --ignore-rules internal-resolution-error && publint packages/api-reference --strict && attw --pack packages/api-reference --profile esm-only --exclude-entrypoints ./css --ignore-rules internal-resolution-error
scripts.fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run format
scripts.analyze: npm run analyze:build && mkdir -p docs/public && cp docs/generated/bundle-report-*.html docs/public
scripts.analyze:build: npm run build:bench --workspace @lattice-php/lattice && SONDA=1 npm run build:standalone --workspace @lattice-php/tree --workspace @lattice-php/board --workspace @lattice-php/media --workspace @lattice-php/map --workspace @lattice-php/pdf --workspace @lattice-php/calendar --workspace @lattice-php/chat --workspace @lattice-php/search --workspace @lattice-php/api-reference --workspace @lattice-php/blocks
scripts.docs:dev: npm run build:lib && npm run dev -w docs
scripts.docs:build: npm run build:lib && npm run analyze && npm run build -w docs
